facts.fact: The Standard reports that NBO2, a data centre platform in Nairobi operated by Digital Realty (the rebranded icolo), was launched at an event with the ICT Principal Secretary; the article's own date for the launch ("Monday, August 7, 2026") conflicts with its 2026-09-07 publication date, so the month of publication is used.

note: Launch of NBO2 recorded as service; no Tier or cloud-region statement; 17 data centres and 200 MW figures are continental, not Kenya.
